title: Bañkat budul nangu
intro: Ci réew yu yàgg ya, amoon na kilifa gu am doole gu yor alal ju bari ak dundu nit ñu bari. Doonte dafa amoon ay firnde ak ay artu yu leer, njiit li tànn na yoonu ñaawtéef, mu jur xeex bu xóot buy wéy ba fàww.
clues: Dama doon wax ni maa am kàttan ak kiliftéef ci wàll wu yaatu.
Ma laaj ab ndaw bu woyof bu Boroom bépp àdduna yónnee.
Sama askan xamoon nañu ko ci seen manin ci tabax yu rëy ak dex giy dundal sunu siwilisasioŋ.
Maa ngi seede kéemtaan yu bari, lu ci melni benn yat bu soppiku nekk jaan ak loxo buy melax bu leer.
Bañ naa bàyyi ay jaam ñu bàyyi sama réew, doonte Yàlla daf ma ko digal.
Lima topp nit ñiy dem, yóbbu ma ak samay soldaar ci biir géej gu xaajaloo.

location.label: Mandargal aspekt
options: Galluwaay bu mag ci kaw ndox

outcome.label: Destin bu mujj
options: Jox alal ju bari ak kàttan

arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verse: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. (7:136)
